title: Shopee Indonesia Product Search Scraper
description: Scrape product search results from Shopee Indonesia (shopee.co.id). Extracts product name, price, discount, shop info, ratings, reviews, and more.

keyword.title: Search Keywords
keyword.description: Keywords to search for on Shopee Indonesia (e.g., 'laptop gaming', 'sepatu nike')

maxPages.title: Max Pages
maxPages.description: Number of pages to scrape. Each page yields up to ~60 products. Max 50 pages (3000 products).

sortBy.title: Sort By
sortBy.description: Sort results by a specific field.

sortByAsc.title: Sort Ascending
sortByAsc.description: Sort direction. True for ascending (low to high for price), false for descending (high to low). Only affects price sort.

minPrice.title: Minimum Price (IDR)
minPrice.description: Filter products with price above this value. Leave 0 for no filter.

maxPrice.title: Maximum Price (IDR)
maxPrice.description: Filter products with price below this value. Leave 0 for no filter.

minRating.title: Minimum Rating
minRating.description: Only return products with this rating or higher. 0 = any rating.

officialShop.title: Official Shop Only
officialShop.description: Only return products from official/brand shops.

shopeeVerified.title: Shopee Verified Only
shopeeVerified.description: Only return products from Shopee-verified sellers.

location.title: Location
location.description: Filter by seller city (e.g., 'Jakarta', 'Surabaya'). Leave empty for all.
